vibe: Objective, rigid, functional, high-performance, and precise. Moves away from typical generic 'SaaS purple' to an authoritative, linear aesthetic.

rules.headings: Tracking tight, uppercase labels with wide tracking, stark contrast between weights (Black vs Light). Never use Inter or Roboto for headings.
rules.body: Clean, highly legible for dense data arrays and chat logs.

colors.rules: 95% monochrome. Color is used strictly as a function (to guide action or indicate status). No generic full-screen gradients. Borders are crisp 1px lines.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous spacing on marketing pages. Dense, highly structured 'Control Room' grid for the dashboard. Progressive disclosure to hide complexity.
spacing_and_layout.dashboard_grid: Grid hierarchy with tight gaps (gap-4). Every pixel utilized. Single-metric focus for top KPIs.
spacing_and_layout.marketing_grid: Bento 'Tetris' grid. Asymmetry and visual tension.
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: rounded-none or rounded-sm. No soft, large pill radiuses unless explicitly needed for a chat bubble.

components.strategy: Shadcn components heavily customized to remove 'Vercel-default' look. Use pure HTML/Tailwind for marketing layout.
components.buttons: Sharp edges, high contrast. Primary button is pure Brand Primary (#002FA7) with white text. Hover state darkens.
components.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border, no soft shadow. Strict, technical look.
components.kanban_board: Columns use border-collapse style. Background is secondary grey. Tickets are stark white cards with strict 1px borders.
components.chat_bubbles: Agent bubbles in light grey, User bubbles in high-contrast primary or stark dark grey. Crisp corners except for the pointing edge.
components.status_badges: Minimalist. Not pill-shaped. Small rectangle with a dot indicator or pure colored text on faint background.
components.knowledge_base_table: Dense data table layout. Right-aligned numbers, left-aligned text. Strict row borders.
components.inputs: Shadcn input with ring-offset removed. Focus state is a sharp 1px or 2px solid primary border, no glow.
components.embed_widget: Floating bottom-right bubble. Expands into a clean, minimalist chat interface matching the Swiss aesthetic.

motion_and_interactions.philosophy: Minimalist, micro-interactions for feedback. Fast, snappy.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Crisp background darkens or border color shifts. No slow, floaty translates.
motion_and_interactions.drag_and_drop: Kanban uses Framer Motion for smooth drag-and-drop feedback. Ghost element on drag.

hero_background.description: Vibrant digital abstract render featuring multi-faceted crystal shapes. Use as a masked overlay or background texture for the marketing hero section.

hero_alt.description: Abstract glass cubes. Can be used in feature sections or AI configuration pages to represent data/RAG.

logo_1.description: Used in the 'Trusted By' section on the landing page.

logo_2.description: Used in the 'Trusted By' section on the landing page.

logo_3.description: Used in the 'Trusted By' section on the landing page.

team_office.description: Can be used in the 'About' or 'For Teams' section on the landing page.

media.icons: Use lucide-react (default). For dense dashboards, Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) is highly recommended for its crisp, technical feel.

testing.attributes: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid. Example: data-testid='ticket-card-123' or data-testid='kanban-column-inprogress'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required fonts (Cabinet Grotesk, IBM Plex Sans, JetBrains Mono) via Google Fonts or custom font faces in index.css.
Implement the landing page using raw HTML/Tailwind for maximum layout control, applying the Bento Grid pattern.
Build the dashboard using heavily customized Shadcn components (1px borders, rounded-none/sm, high contrast text).
Ensure Kanban board uses a robust drag-and-drop library (e.g., @hello-pangea/dnd or standard HTML5 DnD) with clear visual indicators.
Create the embedded chat widget as a fixed, bottom-right element that toggles a chat window.
Apply data-testid to all CTA buttons, nav links, and interactive dashboard elements.
